summary.headline: Frontline-worker device management guidance is added with app-control and agent updates
summary.overview: New getting-started material covers frontline-worker device management. The release also updates app control, macOS LAPS setup, the Security Copilot Change Review Agent, and the Intune data platform schema.
summary.adminImpact: Frontline-device program owners should use the new guide to evaluate their management baseline. Security operations teams using the Change Review Agent should review its updated usage documentation.

summary.headline: Apple Automated Device Enrollment guidance is added as retire and EPM material evolves
summary.overview: The day adds an overview of Apple Automated Device Enrollment for iOS and iPadOS in Intune, alongside updates to the device retire action, EPM support approvals, Configuration Manager remote actions, and the Change Review Agent.
summary.adminImpact: Apple enrollment teams should use the new overview to validate their Automated Device Enrollment design. Endpoint operations should also review updated retire and EPM support-approval guidance before procedural changes.

summary.headline: Compliance policy and custom settings guidance is refreshed
summary.overview: Documentation for creating compliance policies, defining custom JSON, and configuring custom compliance settings was updated. A Configuration Manager application-deployment technical reference was removed.
summary.adminImpact: Compliance-policy owners should consult the refreshed creation and custom-settings references before implementation changes. Update any Configuration Manager bookmarks that point to the removed application-deployment technical reference.

summary.headline: Data-protection overview is added alongside Edge policy and endpoint-security updates
summary.overview: The release introduces an Intune overview for protecting data and devices, updates Edge for Business app-protection policy guidance, and refreshes endpoint-security and policy-management references.
summary.adminImpact: Use the new data-protection overview as a current entry point for security architecture discussions. Teams deploying Edge for Business protection should validate their policy work against the updated step guidance.

summary.headline: Unenrolled-device MAM guidance is added with Android and Apple enrollment updates
summary.overview: Microsoft added a guide for Mobile Application Management on unenrolled devices, while Android MAM, Android application-management migration, and iOS/iPadOS enrollment documentation were updated.
summary.adminImpact: App-protection teams should assess the new unenrolled-device MAM guidance before revising BYOD controls. Android and Apple enrollment owners should recheck the refreshed migration and enrollment guides.
